name: events
summary: Opt-in in-process event dispatcher: typed Publish/On keyed on the event's concrete Go type, synchronous delivery in registration order, panic isolation and joined listener errors. The stable Loom seam selects delivery with its asyncEvents switch: synchronous, or the in-process, best-effort events.Async mode behind a bounded channel with explicit backpressure (TryPublish, or events.TryPublish through the Publisher interface, reports a full queue) that still loses buffered events on exit. Business listeners are wired in the stable internal/di/events_listeners.go seam, automatically consumed by the HTTP application graph before startup; services may also publish without a construction cycle.
